title: Encounter
effect: Roll on an encounter table for that terrain type or location. Don’t forget to roll for NPC reactions if applicable.

title: Sign
effect: The party discovers a clue, spoor, or indication of a nearby encounter, locality, hidden feature, or information about a nearby area.

title: Environment
effect: A shift in weather or terrain.

title: Loss
effect: The party is faced with a choice that costs them a resource (rations, tools, etc), time, or effort.

title: Exhaustion
effect: The party encounters a barrier, forcing effort, care or delays. This might mean spending extra time (and an additional Wilderness Action) or adding Fatigue to the PC's inventory to represent their difficulties.

title: Discovery
effect: The party finds food, treasure, or other useful resources. The Warden can instead choose to reveal the primary feature of the area.
